free_tier.stated: No separate free plan. Shark Pro is USD 5 a month and includes USD 5 of usage; storage has the first 5 GiB free per Space per billing cycle and egress has the first 10 GiB free per Space per billing cycle. Prepaid credit is required beyond the included usage.
free_tier.notes: The included USD 5 of the monthly plan expires at the end of the paid period and does not roll over. There is no free plan; promotions are shown at checkout.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a Space with files, not a single object; a single file upload is capped at 512 MiB and an archive upload at 2 GiB

retention.stated: Spaces and their files persist across commands; op results and output are kept 7 days (410 op_expired); files stay readable when credit runs out and Spaces are hibernated.

egress.terms: USD 0.03 per GB, with the first 10 GiB free per Space per billing cycle, overage only; egress is counted as bytes sent and received by commands over the network
egress.free_allowance: first 10 GiB per Space per billing cycle
egress.price_per_tb: USD 30 per TB at the published USD 0.03 per GB rate

interface_detail: An HTTP API with Python and TypeScript SDKs, and the shark CLI (shark login, shark connect, shark run, shark cp). SDK Spaces are the default; every command runs in a fresh Firecracker microVM.
tooling: pip install sharkmagic or npm install @sharkmagic/sdk; the shark CLI is downloaded from dl.sharkmagic.si; file reads and listings need no VM and are free.
chaining: The REST API and SDKs let a prepaid Sandbox hold an agent's persistent files while each command bills only its own seconds, so it combines with an external model and object storage for checkpointing.

limits.value: USD 5 of included usage per month on Shark Pro, then prepaid credit; a new account runs at most 4 commands at once and holds 20 Spaces for the first 7 days
op results and output expire after 7 days (410 op_expired); a synchronous exec returns the last 1 MiB of each stream and the op log is capped at 32 MiB per stream
100 requests per second per credential, burst 500 (429 rate_limited with Retry-After)

limits_note: A synchronous exec has a default 120 s timeout and a 900 s maximum; a streaming or async exec defaults to 30 min with a 7200 s maximum. Disk per account on the node is 50 GiB, and a Space holds 8 vCPU / 4 GiB for a command. GPUs, non-Linux guests and a published SLA are not available.
binding_note: The USD 5 of included monthly usage is what runs out first on the entry plan: at USD 0.12 per compute-hour on the standard 8 vCPU / 4 GiB shape it buys about 41.7 command-hours, before the 100 requests per second credential rate or the 50 GiB disk cap is met.

identity_cost.detail: The signup page says 'Start with your work email'. A paid plan is bought through Stripe Checkout and top-ups are by card, so a card is needed for the plan or a prepaid credit balance; the signup page itself asks only for email.

reliability_note: At zero balance new work answers 402 credits_exhausted and Spaces are hibernated, though files stay readable; node admission can refuse commands with 503 out_of_capacity, and a synchronous command is capped at 900 s.
confidence_note: The rate, plan, included usage and egress allowance are quoted from the vendor's own billing pages read on 2026-11-24; the signup gate is quoted from the vendor's signup page. Account-specific quotas beyond the published defaults are unverified: they are shown only in an authenticated account.
